what.text: This page follows refugees from Guinea living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 32075 Guinean refugees in France, 67.3% of all refugees from Guinea.
France is the largest host of refugees from Guinea, followed by Germany, Belgium and the United States.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Guinea with the RFDG in 2000 and 2001.
The fact pack records no armed conflict in Guinea in later years, so it does not say why the number of refugees grew.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 255 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
